The National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL), the top tier of professional women’s soccer in the United States, makes its Panini debut with a Donruss Optic collection. NWSL fans can look forward to the iconic Downtown and Night Moves inserts and will find 3 autograph or relic cards per hobby box.

Description

After the licensing rights for the National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL) moved from previous license holder Parkside Collectibles to Panini at the start of the new season, the 2026 PANINI Donruss Optic NWSL Soccer Cards now bring collectors the first hobby collection.

Availability

The release date announced by Panini for 2026 PANINI Donruss Optic NWSL Soccer Cards is Wednesday, the 14th of October 2026. Short-term changes to this date are possible at any time and should be taken into account.

From that date, the boxes will be available from the Panini America online shop or from retailers specializing in sports cards.

2026 PANINI Donruss Optic NWSL Soccer Cards Hobby Box

5 Cards per Pack
16 Packs per Box
12 Boxes per Case
